claims.quote: This species' distribution is unclear although individuals from the aquarium trade are said to have been collected in the Tenasserim river basin in Tanintharyi Region, southern Myanmar.
Scleropages inscriptus is an osteoglossid said to come from the Tenasserim river basin in Tanintharyi Region, southern Myanmar.
